stem.text: A spring is fixed at one end. The length $L$ of the spring is increased by applying a tensile force $F$ to the other end.
The graph shows the variation of $L$ with $F$.

stem.alt: Graph of L/cm against F/N with axis values 0 to 12 cm and 0 to 6 N marked, showing a straight line that rises from the vertical axis to a point with dashed guide lines.

stem.text: What is the elastic potential energy of the spring when $F$ is $6.0\,\text{N}$?
